claims.assertion: Anéeka alleges the Cabal uses genetic data to identify starseeds as nonhuman agents and neutralize them, treating DNA as frequency-coded information about species and individuals.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says humanity comprises many species using human bodies as shared suits; souls, not outward appearance, distinguish them.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says starseed missions are set before incarnation; some enter as commandos, while others fulfill them through ordinary lives and small actions that create large changes.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
